entries.title: Effort and the gem
entries.literal_meaning: If one makes an effort, one finds a gem.
entries.explanation: The small change from jatna, effort, to ratna, gem, gives the line its compact promise. The valuable result is pictured as something worth looking and working for. A speaker can use the conditional line to encourage another attempt when a task seems unrewarding. This encouraging use follows the wording and the dictionary definition of trying; it is not evidence that effort always succeeds. In our reading, the gem gives effort a direction without making failure a verdict on someone’s worth.
entries.meaning_odia: ଯତ୍ନରୁ ରତ୍ନ—ଧ୍ୱନିର ଛୋଟ ବଦଳରେ ଚେଷ୍ଟା ଓ ମୂଲ୍ୟବାନ ଫଳ ପାଖାପାଖି ଆସିଯାଏ। ଖୋଜିବା ଓ କାମ କରିବାର ଆଗ୍ରହକୁ ରତ୍ନର ଚିତ୍ର ଟାଣେ। କୌଣସି କାମରେ ଫଳ ନ ଦେଖି ମନ ଛାଡ଼ିଦେଉଥିବା ମଣିଷକୁ ଆଉଥରେ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବାକୁ ଏହା କୁହାଯାଇପାରେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଏହା ଉତ୍ସାହର କଥା; ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଚେଷ୍ଟାରେ ସଫଳତା ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ବା ଅସଫଳ ମଣିଷର ମୂଲ୍ୟ କମ୍ ବୋଲି ବିଚାର ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: The rhyme encourages effort toward a worthwhile result, without guaranteeing success.
entries.odia_summary: ଯତ୍ନ ଓ ରତ୍ନର ମିଳ ମୂଲ୍ୟବାନ ଫଳ ପାଇଁ ଚେଷ୍ଟାର ଉତ୍ସାହ ଦିଏ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: Two friends are trying to mend a loose chair. After the first adjustment fails, one says “ଯତ୍ନ କଲେ ରତ୍ନ ମିଳେ” and suggests checking the other joint. The line encourages a more careful second attempt rather than promising that the chair must be repairable.
entries.cultural_context: Source definesଯତ୍ନ କରିବା as trying/endeavouring and labels the lineଢଗ. Sound contrast and encouragement are editorial close reading, not a named author’s theory or origin account.

research_commentary.title: Biting the bowl in hunger
research_commentary.literal_meaning: To bite the bowl in the distress of hunger.
research_commentary.explanation: The hunger is real, but the teeth have found the vessel instead of food. This exaggerated image separates a pressing need from an action that cannot satisfy it. Read figuratively, it can describe impatience turning on the nearest thing rather than reaching what is needed. That wider application is our reading of the image; the dictionary defines the distress of hunger and supplies the expression. The humour need not make a hungry person its target: in a friendly exchange it can catch our own hurried, misplaced effort.
research_commentary.meaning_odia: ଭୋକର କଷ୍ଟ ଅଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ କାମୁଡ଼ା ପଡ଼ୁଛି ଖାଦ୍ୟରେ ନୁହେଁ, ତାଟିଆରେ। ଏହି ଅତିରଞ୍ଜିତ ଚିତ୍ରରେ ଦରକାର ଓ ତାହା ମେଣ୍ଟାଇବାର ଉପାୟ ଅଲଗା ହୋଇଯାଏ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ବ୍ୟସ୍ତତା ବା ଅଧୈର୍ଯ୍ୟରେ ଠିକ୍ କାମଟି ଛାଡ଼ି ପାଖର ଜିନିଷ ଉପରେ ରାଗ ସାରିବାକୁ ଏହା ଧରିପାରେ। ନିଜର ଏପରି ଅସହାୟ ତରବରକୁ ହସିକରି କହିବାରେ ଚିତ୍ରଟି ଲାଗେ; ଭୋକିଲା ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ତୁଚ୍ଛ କରିବା ଏଠାରେ ଆମର ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ନୁହେଁ।
research_commentary.english_summary: Urgency can lead to an action that cannot meet the need.
research_commentary.odia_summary: ଦରକାରର ବ୍ୟସ୍ତତାରେ ତାହା ମେଣ୍ଟାଇବାର ଉପାୟ ଭୁଲିଯିବାର ଚିତ୍ର।
research_commentary.usage_example: Original imagined example: A student waiting for a file repeatedly clicks an empty download folder instead of checking whether the transfer has started. A friend quotes the bowl expression; the student laughs, checks the transfer, and stops clicking.
